commands.name: help
commands.description: List available commands or explain one registered command.
commands.certification_implications: None; command discovery produces no certification evidence.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the Fortress CLI implementation version.
commands.certification_implications: None; implementation identity output is not certification evidence.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Build and evaluate a stabilized repository snapshot.
commands.certification_implications: Produces deterministic development audit evidence only; it is not Fortress certification.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Evaluate progressive finding enforcement without rewriting conformance.
commands.certification_implications: Applies authored baseline and exception authority only to blocking behavior; raw rule violations remain failed conformance and certification evidence.

commands.name: findings
commands.description: List current stable finding identities and lifecycle governance.
commands.certification_implications: Reports finding identity, lifecycle, disposition, and enforcement without changing raw conformance or producing certification evidence.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Create or monotonically prune authored legacy finding residue.
commands.certification_implications: Mutates explicit reviewed governance authority only; baseline membership never changes a failed rule result into passing certification evidence.

commands.name: exceptions
commands.description: List, create, or retire finding-specific exception authority.
commands.certification_implications: Mutates finding-specific disposition authority only; an exception remains visible and never becomes proof of conformance.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Discover and explicitly apply snapshot-bound minimal repository governance.
commands.certification_implications: Discovery produces no authority or certification evidence; explicit apply materializes only reviewed canonical authority, and optional baseline creation changes progressive enforcement without changing raw conformance.

commands.name: ccg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Contract Coherency Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders derived semantic intent and coherency only; it is not certification evidence.

commands.name: bfg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Intended Behavioral Flow Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders intended Feature behavior only; it is not implementation realization or certification evidence.

commands.name: realized-bfg
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Realized Behavioral Flow Graph.
commands.certification_implications: Renders coverage-aware intended-to-implementation reconciliation only; it is not a runtime trace, Verified BFG, or certification evidence.

commands.name: psm
commands.description: Compile and render the deterministic Program Semantic Model.
commands.certification_implications: Renders observed executable structure only; it is not behavioral realization, function correctness, or certification evidence.

commands.name: semantic
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic function-domain analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported abstract-domain consequences and explicit uncertainty only; it is not total program safety or certification evidence.

commands.name: state-effect
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic state and effect analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported typestate and effect consequences plus explicit uncertainty only; it is not total heap safety, external-system proof, or certification evidence.

commands.name: information-flow
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic information-flow analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders supported trust/confidentiality propagation, sink contradictions, trusted transitions, and explicit uncertainty only; it is not comprehensive security proof or certification evidence.

commands.name: environmental
commands.description: Compile and render deterministic environmental analysis.
commands.certification_implications: Renders modeled external outcomes, handling totality, retry/idempotency, and bounded recovery consequences plus explicit uncertainty only; it is not comprehensive fault-tolerance proof or certification evidence.

commands.name: certify
commands.description: Execute local verification and certify the exact source snapshot.
commands.certification_implications: Executes the canonical local Rust suite, constructs the content-addressed Evidence DAG, and emits deterministic Certification and Verified BFG artifacts for the exact recursion-free source identity.

commands.name: source-artifacts
commands.description: Compile and render the language-neutral Source Artifact Model.
commands.certification_implications: Renders derived file responsibility, profile/archetype coverage, lightweight semantic references, and structural findings; it does not provide a separate certificate or a language-specific Rust profile.

commands.name: references
commands.description: Resolve stable Module identities and preview relocation-transparent path churn.
commands.certification_implications: Renders current physical projections and non-mutating relocation impact; certification separately proves artifact freshness.
